purpose: Existing agentic benchmark development cohort for DSPy/GEPA optimization and later SFT trajectory collection (HAR-61)
digest_authority: package digests are computed with evallab.task_import.package_digest — the same algorithm as the import ledger (derived/imports/tasks.sqlite3) and each destination directory's name suffix; categories are read from each task.toml [metadata].category

tb2.verified: 89/89 packages carry environment (Dockerfile or pinned docker_image), tests/test.sh, solution/solve.sh; every TB2 file embeds the upstream training-corpus canary
tb2.note: TB2 is development data by Peter directive; not an untouched final test

facet.route: local FACET-Terminal subset at ~/Developer/harbor-rl-exploration/tasks/facet (15 tasks, task_000001..task_000015 series); upstream github.com/StoKou/FACET-Terminal, Apache-2.0
facet.canary_note: FACET upstream ships no training-corpus canary (the source project itself publishes curated SFT rollouts). Imports stay byte-identical to upstream; any FACET-derived training corpus must rely on source-lineage gating, not canary screening.

validation.disjointness: development and validation share no TB2 category (dev: games, personal-assistant, model-training, file-operations, security, software-engineering; val: system-administration, scientific-computing, debugging)

exclusions_sealed.terminal-bench-3: Peter directive 2026-09-16: excluded from search/optimization/data entirely
exclusions_sealed.terminal-bench-4: Peter directive 2026-09-16: excluded from search/optimization/data entirely
exclusions_sealed.mle-bench: resource-blocked: mandatory Kaggle API credentials + terms acceptance, 158 GB (Lite) to 3.3 TB (Full) datasets, ~24 h GPU runs per task (verified from openai/mle-bench repo)
exclusions_sealed.swe-bench-verified: qualified not imported this round: Harbor Hub adapter swe-bench/swe-bench-verified exists (MIT, 500 instances); deferred until repo-repair capability is a target; per-repo images are heavy

baseline_spec.auth: subscription auth file (qualified route; profile zai-opencode-glm-5.3-flash)
baseline_spec.command: uv run evallab run --task <task-dir-above> --agent zai-opencode --model zai-coding-plan/glm-5.3-flash --name <unique> --jobs-dir runs
baseline_spec.note: billable: requires normal approve flow; controls (oracle/nop) are free

rules: development group only may enter DSPy/GEPA optimizer loops
validation group is scored, never optimized on
regenerating an import from the same registry pin must reproduce identical package digests (algorithm: task_import.package_digest, equal to the destination name suffix)
TB2 tasks keep their upstream shared-container verifier; treat reward as terminal signal, not tamper-proof
FACET tasks carry no training-corpus canary (upstream design); use source-lineage gating for any FACET-derived corpus
